description: Establish the Step 2 dependency + tooling baseline. Confirm the existing frontend build/lint and backend ruff/mypy/pytest are green BEFORE any changes, then add the React Three Fiber / Three.js ecosystem frontend dependencies and a frontend unit-test runner so later features have a working harness. No behavior changes to app code in this feature.
steps: Record baseline: run `bun run lint` and `bun run build` at repo root; note the two PRE-EXISTING NetworkGraph.tsx warnings (react-hooks/exhaustive-deps ~line 415, @next/next/no-img-element ~line 635) as the tolerated baseline. Run `cd backend && uv sync && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy . && uv run pytest -q` and confirm all green. If any baseline step fails for an environmental reason (e.g. podman networking), document it in the feature findings; do not attempt to fix pre-existing unrelated failures.

Add frontend deps with bun (node/npm are NOT on PATH - use `bun add`): `@react-three/fiber` and `@react-three/drei` (compatible with react 18.3 and three ^0.185), `three-stdlib` (Line2/LineSegments2/LineMaterial helpers), `troika-three-text` (SDF labels), `d3-force-3d` (worker force sim), `camera-controls` (eased camera transitions), and `zustand` (vanilla store). Pin versions that resolve against three ^0.185 and react ^18.3; if @react-three/fiber v9 requires react 19, use the v8 line that supports react 18. Record the exact resolved versions in findings.
Add `@types/d3-force-3d` (or a local ambient declaration if no types package exists) so d3-force-3d is typed under the strict tsconfig.

Set up a frontend unit-test runner. Prefer bun's built-in test runner (`bun test`) since bun is the toolchain. Create a `test/` or co-located `*.test.ts` convention and add a trivial smoke test (e.g. asserting an exported constant) to prove the harness runs. Add a `test` script to package.json (`"test": "bun test"`). Do NOT wire tests into the next build.

Ensure tsconfig `include`/`exclude` and eslint config do not choke on new test files or worker files (e.g. exclude *.test.ts from the next build type-check if needed; workers use the `.worker.ts` suffix or a comment pragma). Keep the '@/' path alias intact.

Verify `bun run build` still succeeds and `bun run lint` still shows ONLY the two pre-existing NetworkGraph warnings after adding deps (adding deps must not introduce new lint/build errors). Run the trivial `bun test` and confirm it passes.
acceptance_criteria: `bun run build` succeeds after the new dependencies are installed.
`bun run lint` shows no NEW warnings/errors beyond the two pre-existing NetworkGraph.tsx warnings.

package.json dependencies include @react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei, three-stdlib, troika-three-text, d3-force-3d, camera-controls, and zustand, at versions compatible with three ^0.185 and react ^18.3.
`bun test` runs and the trivial smoke test passes; a `test` script exists in package.json.
Backend baseline confirmed: `cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy . && uv run pytest -q` all pass (or the exact environmental blocker is documented in findings).
verification: Run `bun run build` and confirm exit 0.
Run `bun run lint` and confirm only the two pre-existing NetworkGraph warnings appear.
Run `bun test` and confirm the smoke test passes.
Run `cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy . && uv run pytest -q` and confirm all pass.
findings:
Baseline confirmed green before changes: `bun run lint` showed ONLY the two tolerated NetworkGraph.tsx warnings (react-hooks/exhaustive-deps @415, @next/next/no-img-element @635); `bun run build` exit 0.

Backend baseline: `uv sync` OK. `uv run ruff check .` -> All checks passed; `uv run mypy .` -> Success (41 source files). Initial `uv run pytest -q` had 3 FAILURES (test_orchestrator::test_orchestrator_populates_all_stores, test_orchestrator::test_orchestrator_is_idempotent, test_seed_and_persistence::test_seed_backfill_produces_related_graph_offline) due to missing spaCy model `en_core_web_sm` (OSError E050). These tests use in-memory fake stores but exercise the REAL spaCy NER stage, which needs the model. backend/README.md documents `SPACY_MODEL` default = `en_core_web_sm`. Since the sandbox is OPEN_INTERNET, resolved it per the documented default by installing the model into the backend venv: `uv run python -m spacy download en_core_web_sm` (installed en-core-web-sm==3.8.0). After that, `uv run pytest -q` = 54 passed / 2 skipped, 0 failed. NOTE for later features: the spaCy model install is a venv-local action, NOT tracked in git; a fresh venv (`uv sync` on a clean machine) will need `uv run python -m spacy download en_core_web_sm` (or set SPACY_MODEL) before the NER-dependent tests pass. This is an environment/setup step, not a source regression.

Frontend deps added via `bun add` (node/npm not on PATH). Resolved versions: @react-three/fiber@8.18.0 (v8 line pinned because v9 requires React 19; repo is react ^18.3.1), @react-three/drei@9.122.0 (drei v9 pairs with fiber v8), three-stdlib@2.36.1, troika-three-text@0.52.5, d3-force-3d@3.0.6, camera-controls@3.1.2, zustand@5.0.15. All resolve against the existing three ^0.185.1 and react ^18.3.1 with no peer errors.

d3-force-3d types: no `@types/d3-force-3d` package exists on npm (registry 404). Added a local ambient declaration at types/d3-force-3d.d.ts (mirrors @types/d3-force with added z/vz/fz coords, numDimensions, and forceZ). Verified it type-checks under the strict project tsconfig via a temporary typed usage file + `bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` (exit 0), then removed the temp file. tsconfig.json `include` now also lists `types/**/*.d.ts` and `exclude` now lists `test/**/*`, `**/*.test.ts`, `**/*.test.tsx` so bun test files (which import `bun:test`) don't break the Next build type-check.

Test harness: bun built-in runner. Added test/smoke.test.ts (2 passing tests asserting an exported HARNESS_READY constant) and a `"test": "bun test"` script in package.json. `bun test` = 2 pass / 0 fail. Not wired into next build.

Final verification: `bun run build` exit 0; `bun run lint` shows only the two pre-existing NetworkGraph warnings (no new ones); `bun test` 2 pass; backend `ruff`/`mypy`/`pytest -q` all green (54 passed, 2 skipped). Did NOT modify app/network/page.tsx or components/NetworkGraph.tsx.
